scriptLines: source1 derive(amount = iif(isNull(amount) || trim(amount) == '' || lower(trim(amount)) == 'null', toDecimal(0, 10, 2), toDecimal(replace(replace(replace(replace(amount, '$', ''), 'USD', ''), ',', ''), ' ', ''), 10, 2))) ~> amountclean

amountclean derive(payment_status = iif(isNull(payment_status) || trim(payment_status) == '' || lower(trim(payment_status)) == 'null', 'DESCONOCIDO', upper(trim(payment_status)))) ~> paymentstatusclean
paymentstatusclean derive(payment_date = iif(isNull(payment_date) || trim(payment_date) == '' || lower(trim(payment_date)) == 'null', toDate('1900-01-01'), toDate(payment_date))) ~> paymentdateclean
paymentdateclean derive(charge_type = iif(isNull(charge_type) || trim(charge_type) == '' || lower(trim(charge_type)) == 'null', 'DESCONOCIDO', upper(trim(charge_type)))) ~> chargetypeclean
